summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Tests and black were not run, per instructions; line lengths were checked and are within 120 columns. Choices: missing image/label fields are skipped rather than erroring; non-dict top-level JSON and non-list values under the key raise ValueError; input entries are shallow-copied, not mutated. Nothing was committed.
